Update the nearby comments that say 'pkgs.antigravity' to 'pkgs.antigravity-ide' (compressed). VERIFY (against cosmo's OWN pinned nixpkgs, NOT the flake registry — antigravity-ide only exists in the pinned rev): build the affected home config(s) and confirm BOTH warnings are GONE. e.g.:
  nix build .#homeConfigurations."personal".activationPackage --no-link 2>&1 | grep -i 'evaluation warning' || echo 'no warnings'
Build whichever home config(s) surface these (the 'patrick profile' one is Patrick's personal profile; the antigravity one is in dev.nix). Confirm pkgs.antigravity-ide actually resolves in this nixpkgs (the build proves it). Also run nix flake check. Then commit + open PR. Title e.g. 'chore: silence antigravity + pointerCursor eval warnings'.
